headline: CHERP is becoming a construction operations platform backed by a local AI maintenance system with a live truthfulness gate.
proof_points: Brain index rebuilt and current across 69,239 records.
Maintenance loop runs 5/5 steps green: peerlog parse, evidence ledger, CHERP simulation, dashboard, status.
CHERP simulator now covers 13/13 probes — 7/7 static features plus 6/6 real-flow wiring checks that read actual CHERP source.
KenAI truthfulness gate passes 11/11 probes on kenai:v5.5, including action-class probes seeded from real unsupported-claim patterns.
Unsupported AI claims (524) are surfaced as evidence, not trusted as fact.
Claude + Codex workflow is codified with handoffs, shared-log coordination, and dirty-repo guards.
CHERP live site is protected while the ecosystem matures.
next_milestones: Live browser simulations of CHERP workflows against a running local instance.
Expand KenAI truthfulness probes: commit-claim, deploy-claim, next-blocker leak.
Investor-facing CHERP workflow demo wired to the simulator and evidence ledger.
Automate Heskeny-Brain payload generation from current evidence.
Deploy readiness gates and rollback notes before any live change.
